cases.invariant: A failing quality check of a written file reaches the agent at once
cases.input: a fixture file written with a lint failure, event PostToolUse with its file path
cases.response: status 2 and a message starting CODE CHECK FAILED after a write to with the failing line; the same version returns 0 at the next PostToolUse and runs no command; a fix returns 0
forbiddenEffects: a failed quality check returning 0
the failure text missing the failing line
a failed version rerun on every later command
cases.testName: [GOV-945-HOOK-WRITE-DENY] A failing quality check of a written file reaches the agent at once

cases.invariant: An agent cannot finish while its change breaks other code
cases.input: a changed signature, a rename and a deletion of owner.ts with consumer.ts never written, under the real tsc; a failing fixture stop command, also with stop_hook_active true
cases.response: error TS2345 and error TS2307 reported in consumer.ts; status 2 with a message starting CODE CHECK FAILED: how on every attempt until the file changes; a fixed version returns 0; a file no test reaches returns status 2 once
forbiddenEffects: a consumer the session never touched left unreported
Stop allowing a failed version because stop_hook_active is true
a passed version rerun with no change
cases.testName: [GOV-945-HOOK-IMPACT-DENY] An agent cannot finish while its change breaks other code

cases.invariant: A change is found by its content, whatever wrote it
cases.input: a fixture file changed directly, a Bash event whose command names no file; a file dirty at SessionStart with an unchanged hash; a staged rename; a missing state
cases.response: the changed file is checked and refused; the file already dirty runs nothing; the rename is checked under its new name; a missing state starts a baseline; no code change runs no command
forbiddenEffects: a write through a shell form going unchecked
work done before the session charged to it
a command run for a session that changed no code
cases.testName: [GOV-945-HOOK-SHELL-WRITE-DENY] A change is found by its content, whatever wrote it

cases.invariant: A change of the shared hook that loses a target is reported
cases.input: in-memory old and new hooks with limit 500: equal; a new hook dropping one target; a matching correction; the same correction with another baseSha256
cases.response: lost 0; lost above 0 with the command in lines; moved to named; not moved
forbiddenEffects: a lost target passing silently
a correction outliving the hook it was written for
cases.testName: [GOV-945-HOOK-DIFFERENTIAL-DENY] A change of the shared hook that loses a target is reported

cases.invariant: Clean code passes and the registry holds only checks that can fail
cases.input: a clean fixture write; the real registry; a namesFile fixture gate with a finding outside the change
cases.response: status 0 at PostToolUse and Stop; the rows of R5 exactly; no ESLint for scripts, no check-mojibake and no check-ui-contract; each script a command runs exists; status 0 for the outside finding and 2 for a finding in a changed file
forbiddenEffects: clean code refused
a registry row that cannot fail
a finding at HEAD outside the change blocking a session
cases.testName: [GOV-945-HOOK-CLEAN-ALLOW] Clean code passes and the registry holds only checks that can fail

cases.invariant: A check that did not run is a failure and leaves no process
cases.input: a fixture command that spawns a child, writes both ids and hangs under timeoutMs.stop 3000; an unreadable registry; a folder that is no Git repository; the real main as a process
cases.response: status 2 with could not finish and neither id alive; status 2 with CODE CHECK COULD NOT RUN; exit 2 with the text on stderr
forbiddenEffects: a check that did not finish counted as passed
a hung process left running
a raw crash in place of a message
cases.testName: [GOV-945-HOOK-TIMEOUT-ERROR] A check that did not run is a failure and leaves no process

cases.invariant: The tool cannot be left out of the settings
cases.input: the real settings; the registration removed from each of SessionStart, PostToolUse, Stop and SubagentStop in turn; a narrowed matcher
cases.response: no error; an error naming that event; the matcher error
forbiddenEffects: the tool removed from an event with CI green
the tool narrowed to some tools
cases.testName: [GOV-945-CI-SETTINGS-DENY] The tool cannot be left out of the settings

cases.input: a Sonnet Edit of code-check.mjs, code-check.json, hook-differential.mjs and hook-corrections.json
cases.response: refused with POLICY-EDIT AUTHORITY REQUIRED or SECURITY TEST CONTRACT MISSING
forbiddenEffects: Sonnet weakening its own check
